source: Henning 2007 uploaded chapter V; distinction among translation, author inference, later Mipham witness and attributed Mūlatantra

notes.paraphrase: An alternative when birth charts are unknown maps groups of Sanskrit name syllables to lunar mansion categories; script and transliteration are extra inputs.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Within the Vimalaprabhā, a passage attributed to the Mūlatantra says people born at the same instant may experience differing fates because actions also matter.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Henning reads that passage as a criticism of rigid fatalism, not a claim that astrology is meaningless; such qualification does not authorize after-the-fact rescue of failed predictions.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The year-change section approximates a solar period using a ratio involving 399 and 317; Henning notes disagreements over how to interpret its epoch adjustment.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The node calculation uses a 460-fortnight period, with retrograde Head longitude and Tail displaced by half a lunar mansion circle.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: A solar general-day count is reconstructed from lunar days with 707 and 64 subtractions, but the translated source omits a weekday check normally performed in practice.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The translated Mars period is 687 solar days and the karaṇa epoch offset is 167; do not substitute the Phugpa E1927 offset157.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The slow planetary correction has six zodiac-sign sectors per half-circle and uses a planet-specific birth-sign/aphelion, not a person's own zodiac sign.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Fast geocentric correction uses the Sun–planet longitude difference across fourteen mansion steps per half-circle, distinct from the six-sector slow-motion correction.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Traditional Mercury particular-day calculation multiplies general day by 100 before epoch offset and orbital reduction, unlike the outer planets' multiplier one.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Traditional Venus particular-day calculation uses tenfold general day; solar mean longitude plays the slow geocentric role for inner planets.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The Saturn period is 10,766 solar days in the translated computation with its own epoch value; it differs from a modern observational ephemeris period.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The tradition calls Mercury/Venus peaceful inner planets and Mars/Jupiter/Saturn wrathful outer planets, tying visibility to relative Sun conjunction.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Henning describes own-sign conflict rules and attributes additional node or Ketu sign correspondences to Mipham, not universally to the translated Tantra.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: Eclipse contact direction is related to the lunar node and Sun/Moon conjunction; Henning adds a physical explanation, not demonstrated precision or psychological effect.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated

notes.paraphrase: The chapter ends the calendrical translation and states that further detailed planetary step tables and phonetic astrology survive in other passages not translated here.
notes.source_status: English edition only; literal original-language wording not collated
